why: What a shot has to reach, measured, with what usually stands in the way and what the director can do about it. The director (an agent) chooses how a shot reaches its goals and finds why it does not; the engine measures and holds the floors. A new goal is a row. The user, 2026-10-23: "너무 경로를 정해주기보다는 claude 가 목표를 달성하되, 그 과정에서 원인을 찾고 행동하도록 가이드를 주는게 나으려나".

goals.means: a viewer tells what is on screen and what happens in it
goals.measure: the watcher's reads (storyboard judge per take, reel judge per cut)
goals.floor: TAKE_NONE_READS: an agent's pick is refused when no take of the sheet reads

causes.sign: the subject is a sliver or a featureless crop
causes.try: frame it whole or a readable part of it (size, view)

causes.sign: two things must be compared and one is a dot
causes.try: split the comparison over two moments, or bring the small one near the lens

causes.sign: the moment happens off frame or after the cut
causes.try: move key_at or the moment the camera arrives

goals.means: the key moment is on screen and large enough to read
goals.measure: the watcher's key_seen; KEY_* frame probe lines

causes.sign: the key part is under 20 px or hidden
causes.try: a closer moment on it, an opening that faces the camera, or another view

goals.means: what must change on screen is seen changing
goals.measure: CHANGE_* screen measures (change_moves.screen_lines); the watcher's change_seen

causes.sign: CHANGE_TOO_SMALL: the changing part is a few percent of the frame
causes.try: a moment close on it while it changes (far, close, hold), mark it (marks: label, flow), or give it a shot of its own

causes.sign: the camera moves while the change happens and the change reads as reframing
causes.try: hold the camera over the change: two moments with the same framing around the change's window

causes.sign: nothing still is in frame to compare a move or a sinking with
causes.try: keep something fixed in frame (a surface, the ground, another object)

causes.sign: the changing part is small at the shot's size
causes.try: a closer moment on it while it changes, or a shot of its own

goals.size_floor_why: 2026-10-23, submarine r3 against the reel watcher (4 runs): the changes it saw stood at least 0.18 of the frame tall and covered 0.017 of it in their window; the two it did not were a bow tank's water (0.078 tall, 0.0097) and a burst of air (0.47 tall but 0.0039: scattered specks). A marked change (named, its flow drawn) needs half the area - the mark tells which thing to watch. First values; recalibrate on another genre.
goals.floor: CHANGE_TOO_SMALL: an agent's pick of a take whose change shows smaller than the size floor needs its reason

goals.means: a move or a turn is read against something still: the camera holds over it, or something that holds stands in frame
goals.measure: change_moves.masked_lines: the camera's own motion over the change's window against the change's own screen change, with the probe's support share over the window
goals.limits_why: 2026-10-23, first values: the camera rivals the change when its own motion is half the change on screen or more; a still thing in frame is at least 5 % of it (the probe support share) - to be checked against the reel watcher on r3
goals.floor: CHANGE_MASKED: an agent's pick of a take whose change the camera masks needs its reason
goals.try: hold the camera over the change (a rest: the same framing, or hold the previous moment), or keep something still in frame

causes.sign: the camera pushes, pulls or follows while the thing moves
causes.try: rest the camera over the change window (moments, hold)

causes.sign: the camera must move and the frame is empty around the subject
causes.try: bring a still thing into frame (the surface, another object), or place one near the lens

goals.means: a shot where nothing changes still shows something new: what it reveals grows, turns or moves on screen
goals.measure: change_moves.nothing_lines: on a still shot (direction.still), the subject's box on the probe's first and last frames - its size change and how far its middle moves
goals.limits_why: 2026-10-23, submarine r3: of four still shots three changed their subject's size by 0.61-0.63 (pull-backs) and the watcher with the motion map called none dull; one held 0.000 / 0.000 and it was dull four times out of four. First values.
goals.floor: SHOT_NOTHING_SHOWS: an agent's pick of a take where nothing shows needs its reason (a held beat the reel needs)

causes.sign: a still shot held on the whole subject
causes.try: reveal while the line speaks: pull back, go round, or bring the next thing in; or say why the reel rests here

goals.means: the camera never rushes faster than an eye can follow
goals.measure: camera_comfort.peaks: the camera's own fastest half second (scene points held still) - scale (|log size change|), travel (slide in frame widths), turn (roll degrees)
goals.limits_why: 2026-10-23, submarine r3, camera-only measure over 14 picked cuts against the reel watcher's harsh (four runs): the cuts it never called harsh rushed at most scale 0.21, travel 0.09, turn 0.57 deg per half second; the three harsh for their camera rushed scale 2.3 (two pushes), travel 0.61-0.71, turn 5.8-14 deg. Each limit sits in that gap. Three other harsh cuts (an opening that pops, a crossing near the lens, the water's surface) were not the camera's speed. Recalibrate on another genre.
goals.floor: CAMERA_TOO_FAST: an agent's pick of a take past a limit needs its reason

try.scale: start nearer the end framing, give the push more of the shot, or split it into moments with a rest
try.travel: slide a shorter way, or over more of the shot
try.turn_deg: roll less, or over a longer stretch

causes.sign: a push from the whole subject to one small part in a short shot
causes.try: start closer, or two moments: arrive, then go in

causes.sign: the move's timing rushes early (burst) and settles
causes.try: an even timing, or a rest moment before the rush

goals.means: every take's size and angle are a director's choice, not a recipe default
goals.floor: TAKE_FRAMING_DEFAULT: said on the sheet and to the watcher

causes.sign: a compared take carries the recipe's default size
causes.try: write that take under direction.move.others with its settings

goals.means: the director's own take is built, so the comparison includes what was meant
goals.measure: the takes sheet: the own take among the built takes
goals.floor: TAKE_OWN_UNBUILT: an agent's pick is refused while the own take failed, until the move is directed again or --own-why says why another take serves

causes.try: read camera_move_report.json failure (the solve's steps) and the frame report; an engine fault is recorded and reported, never routed around
the recipe has no engine make: write the motion as moments

goals.means: the shot does not move or frame as the reel already does without a reason
goals.measure: TAKE_REPEATS_REEL (recipe_lines over the reel's measured feels); the watchers' repeats

causes.sign: the same recipe and angle as other cuts
causes.try: another side, height or size, or a motion of moments
